adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the recurring-series delete path is now inside `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` (where `bookingCalendarReference` is a `filter` result), so when there are multiple `_calendar` references it will rerun the recurring deletion logic for each reference (duplicating deletions). Additionally, within that recurring branch it iterates over `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and for each `updBooking` it uses `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes("_calendar"))`, which only deletes the first calendar reference per updated booking. This aligns with the finding that deletes can repeat and other hosts’/other references’ events may not be deleted.
